title: Define monolayer geometry and Brillouin zone
action: Set up the fcc Cu(001) monolayer lattice with lattice constant a=3.61 Å, place atoms at the correct Wyckoff positions, define the two‑dimensional unit cell, and identify the Γ=(0,0) and M=(2π/a)(0.5,0) k‑points in the surface Brillouin zone.
description: Process step to define geometry and k-points.

title: Construct crystal and site potentials
action: Construct the full crystal potential V(r) by superimposing spherically averaged free‑atom Cu charge densities with Hartree‑Fock‑Slater exchange (exchange parameter α=0.7). Form muffin‑tin‑like site potentials V_MT^l(r) as piecewise exponential‑tailed potentials (matched to an exponential outside the muffin‑tin radius) and optionally apply variational shifts (e.g., rigid shift or screened Coulomb addition) to tune basis localization.

title: Generate numerical atomic basis functions
action: Solve the radial Schrödinger equation with each V_MT^l(r) on a fine radial grid to obtain site‑centered numerical basis orbitals φ_j(r) and their eigenvalues ε_j. These bound‑state solutions serve as the generating atomic‑like basis functions for the Bloch basis.
description: Process step to generate basis functions.

title: Compute band eigenvalues at Γ and M and identify splittings
action: For the Γ and M k‑points: form Bloch‑sum basis functions χ_j(k,r) from the numerical atomic basis; compute overlap matrix S_ij and Hamiltonian matrix H_ij using the decomposition H_ij = ε_j S_ij + V_ij − ⟨χ_i|D_j⟩ (where V_ij is the matrix element of the full crystal potential and D_j is the correction term defined from the generating potentials); solve the generalized eigenvalue problem Hψ = E Sψ. Identify orbital symmetries (d_xy, d_xz, d_yz, d_x²−y², d_z², s) and extract the energies (in Ry) of: Γ1 (s‑like), Γ3 (d_xy), Γ4 (d_x²−y²), Γ5 (doubly degenerate d_xz,d_yz); and the corresponding M3, M4, M5 states. Compute the splittings Δ(Γ25′) = E(Γ5) − E(Γ3) and Δ(Γ12) = E(Γ4) − E(Γ1). Write all results to band_eigenvalues_ry.json.
description: JSON file containing the computed d‑band and s‑band eigenvalues at Γ and M and the two energy splittings, all in Ry.
